nodes.prompt:
TASK: Implement a typed Rust IPC contract that exposes one canonical initial project derived from the repository root folder, with no default alias, and prove it with tests.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only src-tauri/src/lib.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/project.rs, src-tauri/src/ipc/mod.rs if required, and an existing relevant Rust test file (prefer src-tauri/tests/rorca_native_contract.rs). Add a command named cmd_project_initial (or a clearly equivalent typed command) that returns RegisteredProject for the canonical startup repository. The current checkout must return workspaceId 'orca-lite'. The derivation must use a safe ID accepted by WorkspaceRegistry. Remove the registration of a second 'default' workspace alias for the same root. Legacy frontend requests using workspaceId 'default' for the current root must resolve to the canonical project ID without creating an alias, so persisted old clients migrate safely. Do not modify UI files, docs, config, or unrelated code. Do not commit.
SCOPE: Write only the listed Rust source/test files. Read registry/manager code as needed.
VERIFY: Run 'cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml rorca_native_contract -- --nocapture' or the smallest command that executes the added test; PASS means exit 0 and proves the returned initial ID plus no default alias.
STOP WHEN: The typed IPC is registered, default alias registration is gone, migration behavior is deterministic, and the targeted Rust test exits 0.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Update the App frontend to use typed canonical initial-project IPC and correctly handle a worktree created from a non-active project.
DELIVERABLE: Modify only ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/lib/tauri.ts, and ui/src/App.test.tsx. Add a typed getInitialProject client for backend command cmd_project_initial. With empty/invalid project storage, bootstrap projects from that IPC so the user sees workspaceId 'orca-lite' rather than 'default'; migrate a persisted default project when the backend returns its canonical ID. Do not render Sidebar/project controls until the bootstrap project is resolved, avoiding a visible default flash. Preserve persisted named projects. When AddWorktreeDialog creates a worktree for createTargetProject that differs from activeProject, switch to the owning project, refresh its worktrees, and only then open the worktree so calls do not use active project's runtime/store. Add tests that drive the mocked 'Add worktree to beta' control and assert branch list/create/refresh/open occur for beta, plus a clean-storage bootstrap assertion for orca-lite. Do not modify Sidebar, WorktreeList, Rust files, docs, config, or unrelated code. Do not commit.
SCOPE: Write only the three listed frontend files. The backend command contract is RegisteredProject returned by cmd_project_initial.
VERIFY: Run 'cd ui && bun x vitest run src/App.test.tsx'. PASS means exit 0 and new tests prove startup naming plus non-active project creation routing.
STOP WHEN: App uses the typed initial-project API, clean startup has no default label, and the exact focused test command exits 0.
